    👹 Demon Continent¶

    [!INFO] The Northern Continent The ancestral territory of the demon species on Ge'or. Located west of West Erisdar, separated by the Demonic Sea.

    Overview¶

    The Demon Continent is the homeland of demon-kind, the species descended from allied warriors of The Last Great War. It lies across the Demonic Sea from West Erisdar. The continent was once unified under the Demon King, but after his death it fractured into competing tribes and warlord states.

    Environment¶

    The land of the Demon Continent is painted black, not green. It resembles a desert with scattered trees — harsh, but not lifeless. Crops can be grown, though not as abundantly as on Erisdar or other continents.

    This is not a natural landscape. The black coloration is chemical residue from an orbital bombardment during The Last Great War — a glassing attack by the Hybrian hivemind that struck the 157th Colony research station approximately three million years ago. The same glassing scarred the northern reaches of Lung Continent and Sister Continent, and the far western coast of Erisdar. All human researchers were killed. The land never recovered. The shared struggle against the environment and predators fostered a collaborative culture. The inhabitants view themselves with a shared "demonic" nationality — a point of pride and identity. Inter-species conflict is relatively rare; populations of every race walk freely and mix naturally.

    Nations¶

    • Asatru Empire — largest, spiritual successor to Demon King. Northeast.
    • Blazeyard — Flames species, mountain range. West of Asatru.
    • Emberalden — kobold subrace, taller/stronger. NW of Blazeyard.
    • Malgardian Tribe — humanoid, purple-haired, evolved off-world. West of Emberalden.
    • Tita Tribe — Malgardian subrace (Titians), sacred miko status. West of Malgardians.
    • Bloodcoast — Malgardian-human hybrid, red hair. Above Malgardians/Titians, west of Asatru.
    • Kutra Tribe — humanoid owls, semi-aquatic, can fly. Below Malgardians/Emberalden.
    • Maomodor Kingdom — main demon race, multi-racial. Below Kutra, SW of Blazeyard.
    • Koebi Tribe — demon subrace, taller, green, meditative. SE of Maomodor, south of Blazeyard/Asatru.
    • Zakarutia — snake nation, queen. Sisters (feuding) with Xikxia queen. South of Koebi.
    • Xobkua — Giants (3m). Massive island (~1/4 continent size). SW of Zakarutia.
    • Yaoma Tribe — mermaid-like. Two islands. South of Zakarutia, east of Xobkua.

    Yak Island (east of mainland, across sea)¶

    • Asatru-controlled territory — large land area southeast of the Asatru Empire mainland across the sea
    • Mountain Tribe — Diablos (winged humanoids, nocturnal). Right of Asatru territory.
    • Estran — High Catmen (Mediterranean catmen subrace). Below Mountain Tribe.
    • Cubra Tribe — Demons. Southwest of Estran, across small sea.
    • Yakut — Yak orcs (smaller, more modest). Below Cubra Tribe/Estran.
    • Glub Kingdom — intelligent Slimes. Islands south of Yakut, east of Yaoma territory.
    • Zakarutia-controlled territory — west of Yakut
    • Yaoma-controlled territory — south of Yakut
